_case: REGRESSION PIN for the pagination bug. The tip is two hours old with no deploy record, and the window came back FULL — but its oldest entry (09:00) predates the tip commit (10:00), so the window demonstrably reaches back far enough to prove Netlify never saw this commit. Must be NOT_SEEN_STALE, not PAGINATION_TRUNCATED. Keying on window fullness alone made this branch unreachable in production, where both sites sit at a full 100-deploy window as their steady state. NOTE: this is also the shape produced by the known grace-clock false RED, where a rebased commit carries an old committer timestamp but was pushed seconds ago. See the header of netlify-status.cjs.
